character: Lively base camp of the Belleville valley at 1,850m. At the centre of the world's largest ski area (Les 3 Vallées). Purpose-built with shops, restaurants, and services concentrated in a compact pedestrian centre. Famille Plus certified. Flocon Vert sustainable label. Live music, bowling, ice rink, cinema, pool.
dining: Selection of restaurants in the resort centre. Self-service, Savoyard, pizza, creperie, pizzerias. Live music venues.
shopping: Supermarket, bakery, sports rental and retail, clothing, souvenirs, pharmacy, post office, banks.
apres_scene: Live music bars and pubs. Friendly, lively family atmosphere. Le Schuss, Le Petit Danois.
activities_nearby: Bowling, ice rink, cinema, indoor swimming pool, fitness centre, snowpark, night skiing, snowshoeing, Parc de la Vanoise. 600km Trois Vallées access.
